0022600009.text: The Spurs (0-1, 5th in the Southwest, 0.5 games back, 15th in the West) are at home for their second game of the season after a loss in their opener, while the Rockets have not yet played in 2026-27. Jayden Quaintance is out after knee surgery, and Tobias Harris is out with a calf strain. San Antonio won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 145-120 home win over Houston on March 8, 2026.
